tools.name: 1/8″ flat end mill
tools.notes: 2-flute upcut: general purpose for wood, MDF and plastics.

tools.name: 6 mm flat end mill
tools.notes: 2-flute upcut: general purpose for wood, MDF and plastics.

tools.name: 1/4″ flat end mill
tools.notes: 2-flute upcut: general purpose for wood, MDF and plastics.

tools.name: 60° V-bit (1/4″)
tools.notes: V-carving and engraving; also chamfers.

tools.name: 90° V-bit (6 mm)
tools.notes: V-carving, chamfers and lettering.

tools.name: 1 mm flat end mill
tools.notes: Fine detail and small text. Fragile: shallow passes, slow plunge.

tools.name: 2 mm flat end mill
tools.notes: Small details and tight corners.

tools.name: 3 mm flat end mill
tools.notes: Metric twin of the 1/8″: profiles and pockets.

tools.name: 4 mm flat end mill
tools.notes: 2-flute upcut: general purpose for wood, MDF and plastics.

tools.name: 8 mm flat end mill
tools.notes: Large pockets and fast roughing; needs a rigid machine.

tools.name: 1/8″ downcut end mill
tools.notes: Downcut: a clean top edge on plywood and laminates; it packs chips into the cut.

tools.name: 1/4″ downcut end mill
tools.notes: Downcut: a clean top edge on plywood and laminates; it packs chips into the cut.

tools.name: 1/4″ compression bit
tools.notes: Upcut at the bottom, downcut at the top: clean faces on both sides of plywood. Cut deeper than its downcut section.

tools.name: 1/8″ ball nose
tools.notes: Relief carving and rounded edges; a small stepover leaves a smoother surface.

tools.name: 1/4″ ball nose
tools.notes: Relief carving and smooth, rounded pockets.

tools.name: 1.5 mm ball nose
tools.notes: Fine detail in a relief: finishes the corners a bigger ball cannot reach. Fragile: slow plunge.

tools.name: 3 mm ball nose
tools.notes: Metric twin of the 1/8″: relief carving and rounded edges; a small stepover leaves a smoother surface.

tools.name: 6 mm ball nose
tools.notes: Relief carving and smooth, rounded pockets.

tools.name: 90° V-bit (1/4″)
tools.notes: V-carving, chamfers and lettering.

tools.name: 30° engraving bit (1/8″)
tools.notes: Fine lettering and detailed engraving; shallow cuts.

tools.name: 1″ surfacing bit
tools.notes: Flattening the spoilboard or a slab: light passes with a wide stepover.

tools.name: Ø10 beading bit, R5 (CMT 965.402.11)
tools.notes: CMT decorative beading bit, round-over with a 5 mm radius. Dimensions from CMT; speeds are conservative starting values, not CMT's.

tools.name: 3/4″ beading bit, R6.4 (CMT 865.001.11)
tools.notes: CMT decorative beading bit, 6.4 mm quarter-round with a flat bottom. Dimensions from CMT; speeds are conservative starting values, not CMT's.
